cards.full_time_placement: 90% of students who accepted full-time offers accepted those offers in the U.S. (Class of 2025 FT MSF; data through April 2, 2026 for Dec 2024 / May 2025 / Aug 2025 graduates). Classic seeker-based offer/accept % at 6 months: unknown on the same page. Average base $82,333 (permanent US work-authorized); $81,800 average base for US accepts including non-permanent work-authorized.
cards.full_time_placement_notes: Carroll page markets typical MSF destinations: corporate finance, asset management, investment banking. Page includes explicit international-student caution that US permanent employment has become challenging and recommends dual US + home-country search.
cards.notable_employers_notes: 2023–2025 employer examples listed under MSF section of Carroll Career Development page — not a ranked Class of 2025 multi-hire census.
cards.top_finance_firm_signal: Moderate-high Boston corridor signal (KKR example, AM/PE boutiques, A&M, BCG). Bulge multi-hire density not quantified on page.
cards.referral_network_notes: Carroll Graduate Career Development; Eagle Exchange alumni mentoring; BC alumni network. Formal referral ease: unknown.
cards.difficulty_notes: Multiple graduation terms (Dec/May/Aug) in reporting window. Boston finance market competitive.
cards.intl_student_notes: Official career page warns intl students that US permanent employment has become challenging and recommends global search. Exact Class of 2025 intl %: unknown. Confirm STEM status with Carroll for Fall 2027 OPT.
